value.syntax: # [doc = " Refused values of the executable-owned emission setting."] # [derive (Debug , Clone , PartialEq , Eq , thiserror :: Error)] pub enum EmissionConfigurationError { # [doc = " A valid release disable request conflicts with an explicit level."] # [error ("PN_OBSERVE_DISABLE conflicts with PN_OBSERVE_LEVEL")] ConflictingInputs , # [doc = " Only one exact spelling selects quiet release."] # [error ("PN_OBSERVE_DISABLE must be 1 when present")] InvalidDisable , # [doc = " The disable input is public UTF-8 text."] # [error ("PN_OBSERVE_DISABLE must be UTF-8: 1")] NonUtf8Disable , # [doc = " A debug build always observes terminal errors."] # [error ("debug observation cannot be disabled")] DebugCannotDisable , # [doc = " Environment-owned exporter settings bypass secret-owned acquisition."] # [error ("{0} refused; use secret-owned ExportConfig")] ExporterEnvironment (String) , # [doc = " Only the two declared emission modes are accepted."] # [error ("PN_OBSERVE_LEVEL must be error, default or trace")] UnknownLevel , # [doc = " Configuration is text and must not be decoded lossily."] # [error ("PN_OBSERVE_LEVEL must be UTF-8: error, default or trace")] NonUtf8Level , }
